WITH bucket_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt1,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_ext_tax1,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax1,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt2,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_ext_tax2,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax2,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt3,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_ext_tax3,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax3,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt4,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_ext_tax4,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax4,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt5,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_ext_tax5,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax5
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE (ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN stats.cnt1 > 1071 THEN stats.avg_ext_tax1 ELSE stats.avg_net_paid_inc_tax1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN stats.cnt2 > 39161 THEN stats.avg_ext_tax2 ELSE stats.avg_net_paid_inc_tax2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN stats.cnt3 > 29434 THEN stats.avg_ext_tax3 ELSE stats.avg_net_paid_inc_tax3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN stats.cnt4 > 6568 THEN stats.avg_ext_tax4 ELSE stats.avg_net_paid_inc_tax4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN stats.cnt5 > 21216 THEN stats.avg_ext_tax5 ELSE stats.avg_net_paid_inc_tax5 END AS bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN bucket_stats AS stats ON true
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
